Run a deterministic matrix covering successful promotion plus every negative required by the three predecessor tasks. Tests use fixtures/mocks only and prove the live supervisor PID is never signalled.

Create one clean integration PR from current dev with correct title/body and only this task ancestry; every commit and PR body uses the exact Task-ID, LLM-Agent Antigravity, Reviewer Human/Ops and validation trailers.
Close polluted PR #4433 only after the clean integration PR exists and links the supersession. Do not reuse or approve any prior #4433 head.
All repository checks and root merge-freeze status must be green on the exact reviewed head before Human/Ops approval and protected merge.

After merge, do not promote live automatically. Hand off the merged helper to SUP-AGENT-ALIAS-GUARD-LIVE-PROMOTION-20260731 as the resolved rollback-contract dependency and use the next already-governed runtime promotion as canary.
No edits to .orchestrator/config.json, live-supervisor-mainroot-config.json, canonical JSON, provider policy, product controllers, or live services.
Work only in a clean governed task worktree on the exact task branch, target dev, and keep unrelated or generated task-brief changes out of commits.

Deliver focused commits with LLM-Agent: Antigravity, exact Task-ID, Reviewer: Human/Ops and Verified trailers; push, open a correctly titled PR to dev, wait for all checks, and require exact-head Human/Ops review before merge.

Rollout: merge source, then separate Human/Ops-governed live canary with gate-before-switch. Rollback: revert the integration and predecessor merge commits in reverse order; live canary rollback restores its captured incumbent.
